tool_declarations.name: mempalace_status
tool_declarations.description: Palace overview — total drawers, wing and room counts

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_list_wings
tool_declarations.description: List all wings with drawer counts

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_list_rooms
tool_declarations.description: List rooms within a wing (or all rooms if no wing given)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_get_taxonomy
tool_declarations.description: Full taxonomy: wing → room → drawer count

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_get_aaak_spec
tool_declarations.description: Get the AAAK dialect specification — the compressed memory format MemPalace uses. Call this if you need to read or write AAAK-compressed memories.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_query
tool_declarations.description: Query the knowledge graph for an entity's relationships. Returns typed facts with temporal validity. E.g. 'Max' → child_of Alice, loves chess, does swimming. Filter by date with as_of to see what was true at a point in time.

as_of.description: Date/datetime filter — only facts valid at this time (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_add
tool_declarations.description: Add a fact to the knowledge graph. Subject → predicate → object with optional time window. E.g. ('Max', 'started_school', 'Year 7', valid_from='2026-09-01'). Pass valid_to to backfill an already-ended historical fact in a single call.

valid_from.description: When this became true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional)

valid_to.description: When this stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional). Use for backfilling already-ended historical facts.

source_closet.description: Closet ID where this fact appears (optional)

source_file.description: Source file path the fact was extracted from (optional)

source_drawer_id.description: Drawer ID the fact was extracted from (optional, RFC 002 provenance)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_invalidate
tool_declarations.description: Mark a fact as no longer true. E.g. ankle injury resolved, job ended, moved house.

ended.description: When it stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, default: today)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_supersede
tool_declarations.description: Atomically replace a fact with its successor at a shared boundary. Use when a single-valued fact changes (model, employer, address) instead of separate kg_invalidate + kg_add — a point-in-time query at the boundary then returns only the new value.

subject.description: The entity whose fact is changing

at.description: Boundary instant (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional; defaults to now UTC)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_timeline
tool_declarations.description: Chronological timeline of facts. Shows the story of an entity (or everything) in order.

entity.description: Entity to get timeline for (optional — omit for full timeline)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_kg_stats
tool_declarations.description: Knowledge graph overview: entities, triples, current vs expired facts, relationship types.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_traverse
tool_declarations.description: Walk the palace graph from a room. Shows connected ideas across wings — the tunnels. Like following a thread through the palace: start at 'chromadb-setup' in wing_code, discover it connects to wing_myproject (planning) and wing_user (feelings about it).

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_find_tunnels
tool_declarations.description: Find rooms that bridge two wings — the hallways connecting different domains. E.g. what topics connect wing_code to wing_team?

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_graph_stats
tool_declarations.description: Palace graph overview: total rooms, tunnel connections, edges between wings.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_mesh_peers
tool_declarations.description: Mesh estate snapshot (RFC 004): this replica's identity, version vector and node profile; each configured peer's reachability, last sync outcome, remote version vector and advertised profile; origins known only transitively; origin_profiles keyed by replica_id; and estate_source saying whether the peer status was observed in this process or published by the palace's hub (with published_at and whether that hub is still alive). Exactly the GET /sync/peers payload — tokens are never included.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_create_tunnel
tool_declarations.description: Create a cross-wing tunnel linking two palace locations. Use when content in one project relates to another — e.g., an API design in project_api connects to a database schema in project_database.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_list_tunnels
tool_declarations.description: List all explicit cross-wing tunnels. Optionally filter by wing.

wing.description: Filter tunnels by wing (shows tunnels where wing is source or target)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_delete_tunnel
tool_declarations.description: Delete an explicit tunnel by its ID.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_list_hallways
tool_declarations.description: List within-wing hallway records (entity-to-entity co-occurrence links built at mine time). Optionally filter by wing.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_delete_hallway
tool_declarations.description: Delete a hallway record by its ID. Returns {deleted: bool}.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_follow_tunnels
tool_declarations.description: Follow tunnels from a room to see what it connects to in other wings. Returns connected rooms with drawer previews.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_search
tool_declarations.description: Semantic search. Returns verbatim drawer content with similarity scores. IMPORTANT: 'query' must contain ONLY search keywords. Use 'context' for background. Results with cosine distance > max_distance are filtered out.

query.description: Short search query ONLY — keywords or a question. Max 250 chars.

source_file.description: Filter to one exact source_file (optional). Matches the full stored path exactly (leading/trailing whitespace trimmed); no glob or basename matching. Pass the value from a result's 'source_path' field; the displayed 'source_file' is only a basename.

since.description: Only drawers filed on/after this ISO date or datetime (inclusive), e.g. '2026-04-01' or '2026-04-01T09:30:00'. Compares the drawer's created_at (filed_at) wall-clock; drawers without a filed_at are excluded while set.

before.description: Only drawers filed strictly before this ISO date or datetime (exclusive). Same comparison rules as 'since'.

max_distance.description: Max cosine distance threshold (0=identical, 2=opposite). Results further than this are dropped. Lower = stricter. Default 1.5. Set to 0 to disable.

candidate_strategy.description: Candidate source strategy. 'vector' preserves default semantic search; 'union' also merges backend BM25 lexical candidates before reranking.

cli_compatible.description: Preserve standalone CLI candidate selection, ranking, and output. Used by the CLI Hub forwarder.

context.description: Background context for the search (optional). NOT used for embedding — only for future re-ranking.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_check_duplicate
tool_declarations.description: Check if content already exists in the palace before filing

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_add_drawer
tool_declarations.description: File verbatim content into the palace. Checks for duplicates first.

content.description: Verbatim content to store — exact words, never summarized

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_checkpoint
tool_declarations.description: Save a whole session in one call: semantic-dedups each item, files non-duplicates as drawers, then writes one diary entry. Use this instead of many separate check_duplicate/add_drawer/diary_write calls — it renders as a single tool-call card in the host UI.

items.description: Verbatim items to file. Each is {wing, room, content} — content is the exact words, never summarized.

diary.description: Optional diary entry written after filing: {agent_name, entry, topic?, wing?}. entry is AAAK-format.

dedup_threshold.description: Similarity threshold 0-1 for the per-item dedup check (default 0.9)

added_by.description: Who is filing these drawers. An explicit value takes precedence; otherwise the diary agent_name, else 'checkpoint'.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_delete_drawer
tool_declarations.description: Delete a drawer by ID. Irreversible.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to delete

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_mine
tool_declarations.description: Mine a directory into the palace — the MCP equivalent of `mempalace mine`. mode='convos' also accepts a single conversation file. mode='projects' (default) ingests code/docs; mode='convos' ingests chat transcripts; mode='extract' ingests office documents (PDF/DOCX/RTF, requires the mempalace[extract] extra). Runs synchronously and returns the miner's summary as `output`. The palace write lock is automatic; a concurrent mine returns a structured already-running error. Orphan cleanup is separate — use mempalace_sync.

source.description: Directory to mine, or one conversation file with mode='convos'.

mode.description: Ingest mode: projects (code/docs, default), convos (chat transcripts), extract (office docs).

limit.description: Max files to process (0 = all). Default: 0.

dry_run.description: Report what would be filed without writing. Default: false.

extract.description: Convos extraction strategy: exchange (default) or general. Ignored by other modes.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_delete_by_source
tool_declarations.description: Bulk-delete every drawer mined from one source_file (exact match). Use to clean up benchmark/test data accidentally mined into a user wing (#1722). Returns a dry-run match count and sample by default; pass dry_run=false to commit. Irreversible.

source_file.description: Exact source_file metadata value to remove (e.g. the full path that was mined)

dry_run.description: Preview the match count without deleting; default true. Pass false to actually delete.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_sync
tool_declarations.description: Prune drawers whose source files are gitignored, deleted, or moved. Returns dry-run report by default; pass apply=true to commit deletions.

project_dir.description: Project root to scope the sync (optional; auto-detected from drawer metadata if omitted)

apply.description: Actually delete drawers; default is dry-run preview

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_get_drawer
tool_declarations.description: Fetch a single drawer by ID — returns full content and metadata.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to fetch

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_list_drawers
tool_declarations.description: List drawers with pagination. Optional wing/room filter and since/before date filter on filed_at (since inclusive, before exclusive; drawers without a parseable filed_at are excluded when a date bound is set). Returns IDs, wings, rooms, content previews, and total matching count for pagination.

since.description: Only drawers filed on or after this ISO date/time, inclusive (e.g. '2026-04-01'). Optional.

before.description: Only drawers filed before this ISO date/time, exclusive (e.g. '2026-05-01'). Optional.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_update_drawer
tool_declarations.description: Update an existing drawer's content and/or metadata (wing, room). Fetches existing drawer first; returns error if not found.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to update

content.description: New content (optional — omit to keep existing)

wing.description: New wing (optional — omit to keep existing)

room.description: New room (optional — omit to keep existing)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_diary_write
tool_declarations.description: Write to your personal agent diary in AAAK format. Your observations, thoughts, what you worked on, what matters. Each agent has their own diary with full history. Write in AAAK for compression — e.g. 'SESSION:2026-04-04|built.palace.graph+diary.tools|ALC.req:agent.diaries.in.aaak|★★★'. Use entity codes from the AAAK spec.

agent_name.description: Your name — each agent gets their own diary wing

entry.description: Your diary entry in AAAK format — compressed, entity-coded, emotion-marked

wing.description: Target wing for this diary entry (optional). If omitted, uses wing_{agent_name}. Use this to write diary entries to a project wing instead of an agent-specific wing.

content.description: Alias for 'entry' — accepted because add_drawer uses 'content'. Provide either 'entry' or 'content'; 'entry' wins if both are given.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_diary_read
tool_declarations.description: Read your recent diary entries (in AAAK). See what past versions of yourself recorded — your journal across sessions.

agent_name.description: Your name — each agent gets their own diary wing

last_n.description: Number of recent entries to read (default: 10)

wing.description: Wing to read diary entries from (optional). If omitted, reads from wing_{agent_name}.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_hook_settings
tool_declarations.description: Get or set hook behavior. silent_save: True = save directly (no MCP clutter), False = legacy blocking. desktop_toast: True = show desktop notification. Call with no args to view.

silent_save.description: True = silent direct save, False = blocking MCP calls

desktop_toast.description: True = show desktop toast via notify-send

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_memories_filed_away
tool_declarations.description: Check if a recent palace checkpoint was saved. Returns message count and timestamp.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_reconnect
tool_declarations.description: Force reconnect to the palace database. Use after external scripts or CLI commands modified the palace directly, which can leave the in-memory HNSW index stale.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_event_append
tool_declarations.description: Append an immutable agent-coordination event to the logstream (RFC 003). Use for delegating work (task.request), replying (task.reply), and announcing artifacts (patch.ready). Events are append-only; corrections are new events.

topic.description: Topic to group related work/sub-team, e.g. 'auth-v2', 'ui-redesign' (optional)

correlation_id.description: Task/conversation id tying request and reply events (optional)

base_commit.description: Git commit the work started from (optional)

status.description: One of: open, claimed, ready, applied, blocked, failed, superseded (optional)

artifact_ids.description: Ids of already-stored artifacts to reference (optional)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_task_create
tool_declarations.description: Create a complete immutable task.request for another agent and return its exact stored event plus one short ready-to-paste handoff line. Use this instead of assembling raw task fields, especially when connected to a remote shared-brain hub. The caller must preview the exact task with the user before this append.

base_commit.description: Immutable hexadecimal commit id the worker must start from; branches and tags are rejected

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_event_list
tool_declarations.description: List agent-coordination events with structured filters. Use order='desc' to return newest events first (e.g. for sweeping recent inbox or inspecting project tail in a single call); default order is 'asc' (oldest first, append order). Use since_event_id as the resume cursor: it means strictly AFTER that event in append order (rowid > anchor), so it cannot skip anything. For reverse/historical paging, use before_event_id (rowid < anchor). Do NOT resume with since_created_at — a peer's event syncs in whenever it arrives, so it can already be older than a timestamp cursor and be missed permanently; since_created_at is a time window ('what happened today'), not a cursor. Pass preview=true when sweeping a busy stream. to_agent=<you> also matches '*' broadcasts. To wait for future events, use mempalace_event_wait.

to_agent.description: Filter by target agent; also matches '*' broadcasts (optional)

since_event_id.description: Return only events strictly after this event id in append order (optional)

before_event_id.description: Return only events strictly before this event id in append order (optional)

since_created_at.description: Time window filter, inclusive: events created at or after this time (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional). NOT a resume cursor — use since_event_id for that; a timestamp cursor silently drops peer events that sync in late. Dedup by id when using this.

preview.description: Truncate each event body to a short excerpt (marks body_truncated + body_length) so scanning many events stays cheap. since_event_id is strictly AFTER that id, so do not pass the truncated event's own id to re-fetch it — repeat the original filters with preview=false (default false)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_event_wait
tool_declarations.description: Block until a matching coordination event exists or the timeout expires (default 60s, max 5 minutes). Returns {timed_out: true, events: []} on timeout — a normal result, not an error. This is the right tool for actively waiting on a correlation_id you delegated or claimed. It already backs off internally, so do not wrap it in a tight retry loop: on timeout just call it again with since_event_id updated to the last event you processed. For long-lived consumers (daemons, dashboards) prefer the push stream at GET /logstream/stream, which takes the live-tail filter subset and the same since_event_id resume.

to_agent.description: Filter by target agent; also matches '*' broadcasts (optional)

since_event_id.description: Only match events strictly after this event id (optional)

since_created_at.description: Time window filter, inclusive (optional). NOT a resume cursor — use since_event_id, which cannot skip a late-syncing peer event.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait in milliseconds (default 60000, max 300000)

limit.description: Max events to return when matches exist (default 50)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_event_ack
tool_declarations.description: Acknowledge a coordination event: appends a new event.ack routed back to the original writer with the correlation id copied. Never mutates the target event.

event_id.description: Id of the event to acknowledge

status.description: One of: open, claimed, ready, applied, blocked, failed, superseded (optional)

topic.description: Topic override (defaults to target event's topic, optional)

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_artifact_put
tool_declarations.description: Store exact artifact content (unified diff patch, file, log, json, note) for agent handoffs. Returns id, sha256, and size_bytes. UTF-8 text only, max 4 MiB.

kind.description: One of: patch, file, log, json, note

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_artifact_get
tool_declarations.description: Fetch a coordination artifact by id — exact content plus sha256 for verification.

tool_declarations.name: mempalace_patch_submit
tool_declarations.description: Convenience: store a patch artifact and append its patch.ready event in one call. Use when handing completed work to another agent.

correlation_id.description: Task id tying this patch to its request (optional)

base_commit.description: Git commit the patch applies to (optional)
